description.narrative: (Egypt): The Teach for Tomorrow activity supports the Ministry of Education and Technical Education to improve, implement, and monitor its continuous professional development system for primary school teachers. As part of its groundbreaking reform, the Ministry recently developed a new curriculum, and Egypt requires an effective teacher professional development system for teachers to gain the skills to implement this curriculum. To date, Teach for Tomorrow has collaborated with the Ministry to draft teacher competencies and develop teacher pedagogical standards that will guide all pre-service and in-service teacher professional development. Using FY 2021 funds, the activity will design digital training materials for 60,000 teachers to gain the skills to effectively deliver the new curriculum. Teach for Tomorrow will also improve the Ministry's capacity to effectively monitor teacher performance, identify teacher needs, and provide coaching and mentoring. The activity will partner with the Ministry to develop incentives to reward teachers based on their performance, rather than their length of service.
